title: DisasterDoc small seeded image-level evaluation
scope: Synthetic-only end-to-end evaluation through the unchanged EasyOCR and DisasterDoc pipeline.
ground_truth_policy: source values and ground_truth are evaluation-only metadata. The runner passes only generated image bytes to run_pipeline; truth is compared only after the pipeline returns.
image_corruption_policy: For semantic-edit cases, the altered target string is rendered into image pixels using the existing synthetic card renderer. It is never sent as an OCR/classifier input. The original source value remains the evaluation ground truth.
